title: Add clippy config to generated Rust CLI template
intent: Generated Rust CLI tools should inherit consistent clippy settings from the template.
expected_deliverable: clippy config exists in the Rust CLI template
generated repo check/run path respects it
no product-specific clippy settings are added to coherence-core-db

title: Auto-initialize Dolt identity in generated dolt-start script
intent: Generated repositories should start repo-local Dolt without requiring global dolt config on fresh machines.
expected_deliverable: scripts/dolt-start initializes .dolt with dolt init --name/--email when missing
identity source priority is env vars, then git config, then deterministic fallback
no writes to global dolt config are required for M0 startup
